description: Starfighter on a plinth beside the İncirlik approach road at Yüreğir, outside the base perimeter. It carries the code 10-101 representing 10 AJÜ 101 Filo; the International F-104 Society records the underlying airframe identity as unknown, so tail_number is deliberately blank. Independently present in OpenStreetMap as a tourism attraction node named F-104 Starfighter at 36.99275 35.39249.
museum_name: İncirlik Yolu F-104 Monument -- Yüreğir, Adana
